name: Gulf Shores Entertainment Agency
description: Gulf Shores Entertainment Agency is a fully integrated marketing, production and event planning firm. We have 15 years of experience in talent buying, event planning, and production all over America with 8 years of experience in marketing on the Gulf Coast. We provide talent buying, event planning, production and promotion. We work hand in hand with your marketing team and venue management. Hosting a private house party, corporate event, family reunion, wedding, anniversary or birthday party? We supply family friendly performers who will entertain your guests of all ages. We have it all; magicians, singers, comedians, impressionists, bands and djs.
